name: Safrazine
summary: Safrazine (Safra) is a non-selective, irreversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine class that was introduced as an antidepressant in the 1960s, but has since been discontinued alongside several old generation MAOIs in favor of the invention of RIMAs and more efficacious treatments for depression in general.

pharmacology.text: Safrazine (Safra) is a non-selective, irreversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine class that was introduced as an antidepressant in the 1960s, but has since been discontinued alongside several old generation MAOIs in favor of the invention of RIMAs and more efficacious treatments for depression in general.

uses.text: Safrazine (Safra) is a non-selective, irreversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine class that was introduced as an antidepressant in the 1960s, but has since been discontinued alongside several old generation MAOIs in favor of the invention of RIMAs and more efficacious treatments for depression in general.

sideEffects.en: Little is recorded about it specifically. Hydrazine MAOIs as a group can cause dizziness on standing, sleep problems and liver damage, and can trigger dangerous rises in blood pressure and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它本身的紀錄不多。肼類單胺氧化酶抑制劑整體而言可能引起起身頭暈、睡眠問題和肝損傷，也可能引發危險的血壓飆升和血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它本身的纪录不多。肼类单胺氧化酶抑制剂整体而言可能引起起身头晕、睡眠问题和肝损伤，也可能引发危险的血压飙升和血清素症候群。

fact.en: Safrazine joins a hydrazine group, the part that blocks monoamine oxidase, to the methylenedioxy ring also found in safrole and MDMA.
fact.zh: Safrazine 把抑制單胺氧化酶的肼基，接到黃樟素和 MDMA 中也有的亞甲二氧基環上。
fact.zhHans: Safrazine 把抑制单胺氧化酶的肼基，接到黄樟素和 MDMA 中也有的亚甲二氧基环上。
